test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 08 Dec 2022 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Wavering
solution: The correct answer is **'Fluctuating'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The given word '**wavering**' means to vacillate irresolutely between choices; fluctuate in opinion, allegiance, or direction. (विकल्पों के बीच अनिश्चित रूप से ढुलमुल होना: राय, निष्ठा या दिशा में उतार-चढ़ाव) • ***Example**: His mind is so **wavering** to choose or decide between the two given options.* • *​*The marked option** 'Fluctuating'** means to change frequently from one thing to another.(बार-बार उतार-चढ़ाव होना) • From the given meaning and example sentence, it is obvious that** 'Wavering' **and **'Fluctuating' **are synonyms. • Thus, the correct answer is **option 3.** ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__** • Let's look at the **meaning **of the other words given in options:- • **Sickly - **often ill; in poor health. (अक्सर बीमार; कमज़ोर स्वास्थ्य) • **Drenching - **wet thoroughly; soak. (अच्छी तरह से गीला; डुबाना) • **Unconvincing - **failing to make someone believe that something is true or valid. (किसी को यह विश्वास दिलाने में असफल होना कि कुछ सत्य या मान्य है) 17e:T69d, The correct answer is **'Go bankrupt'.**
